youtube_title: The '100 m Queue = Free Toll' Rule? NHAI Withdrew It #Shorts
youtube_description:
Rules You Didn't Know #5. That viral message says if the queue at a toll plaza is longer than 100 metres you can pass without paying. In May 2021 NHAI did issue guidelines: service time of no more than 10 seconds per vehicle, and if the queue crossed a 100 m yellow line the barrier was to be lifted. But on 19 August 2024 NHAI deleted that provision, because the National Highways Fee Rules 2008 have no such exemption, and the rule only covered new-design plazas. So even with a long queue, the toll still applies. Problem at a toll plaza? Call the NHAI helpline 1033.
Source: NHAI circular, 19 Aug 2024 (reported by Business Standard, 22 Aug 2024).
